title: Quaint Buttery Moroccan Pumpkin Rfissa
description: A traditional Moroccan rfissa dish featuring roasted pumpkin, onions, and a blend of spices, served with a side of crusty bread for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Toss the pumpkin and onions with 2 tablespoons of butter, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet
Roast the pumpkin and onions in the oven for 30 minutes or until tender
In a large skillet, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until lightly browned
Stir in the roasted pumpkin and onions, parsley, and feta cheese
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through
Serve the rfissa hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired
